summary: Re-test of iteration_2 fixes for ZARAHATKE. Backend: ran full pytest suite (50 tests) - 100% pass including Stripe session creation, COD order persistence, shipping thresholds, category/look endpoints. Frontend (Playwright, public URL): all FOUR reported fixes verified working - (1) Home renders all 8 new-arrival + 6 best-seller cards, (2) CartSheet checkout-btn now client-side navigates to /checkout with items intact (checkout-page rendered, checkout-empty absent), (3) cart & wishlist persist in localStorage (zk_cart/zk_wishlist) across page reload with correct badge counts, (4) /category/dresses shows 'This collection is on its way' instead of the filter-empty copy. Regressions verified: COD e2e order -> /order/:id confirmation, PDP size enforcement alert + BUY IT NOW -> /checkout, price filter & sort, header nav to category, shoppable Instagram modal + shoppable-add. ONE NEW defect found: cart is never cleared after a successful COD order.

integration_issues.issue: clearCart() is only called in PaymentSuccess.jsx (Stripe path). After a successful COD order the cart still contains the ordered items and, because of the new localStorage persistence, the stale cart now survives reloads forever - cart badge still showed 1 on the /order/:id confirmation page. User can accidentally re-order. Fix: call clearCart() after a successful COD order response in Checkout.jsx.

action_items: Call clearCart() in Checkout.jsx after a successful COD order (currently only Stripe path clears the cart)
critical_code_review_comments: StoreContext.removeFromCart/updateQty key off product.id only, while addToCart dedupes by id+size. Same product added in two sizes creates two lines but removing/updating one removes/updates both. Should operate on the composite `key`.
Checkout.jsx does not clear the cart on COD success - now user-visible because of localStorage persistence.
seed_data_creation: One COD test order created (TEST QA User, qa_test@example.com, order id 7e59e16e-0775-4635-a821-30f7a2905b28).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart/wishlist persist in localStorage keys zk_cart / zk_wishlist - clear localStorage between test cases. Shoppable modal auto-closes on shoppable-add click (by design), so close-shoppable-modal will not be found after adding. PDP add-to-cart auto-opens the cart drawer whose overlay intercepts clicks - close the drawer before clicking pdp-buy-now. Console shows a React hydration warning about <span> inside <option>; it comes from the Emergent dev instrumentation attributes, not app code.
rca_of_the_issue: Cart-not-cleared: grep shows clearCart referenced only in PaymentSuccess.jsx; the COD branch in Checkout.jsx navigates to /order/:id without resetting store state, and the StoreContext useEffect re-writes the stale cart to localStorage.
